nodes.prompt: You need ₹30,000 to buy seeds and fertilizer for the season. Where do you borrow?
nodes.voicePrompt: बीज और खाद के लिए ₹30,000 चाहिए। आप कहाँ से उधार लेंगे?

nodes.prompt: You repaid ₹32,100 (7% interest after 1 year). Formal credit costs least!
nodes.lesson: Kisan Credit Card offers loans at 7% p.a. (4% with subsidy). It is the cheapest and most farmer-friendly credit option in India.

nodes.prompt: After a bad harvest, you can't repay ₹39,000. Interest compounds. Two seasons later you owe ₹65,000.
nodes.lesson: Informal moneylender debt often traps families for generations. Always opt for formal banking credit, even if it takes longer to process.

nodes.prompt: SHG loan at 12% was manageable. You repaid ₹33,600. Better than a moneylender!
nodes.lesson: Self-Help Groups are a great community-based alternative to moneylenders. Join or form a local SHG to access collective credit.
